rationale.conceptual: The paper uses established DFT/DFPT methods with PBE functional and PAW pseudopotentials, but the analysis of mode effective charges and per-atom dielectric contributions requires careful implementation of well-known but non-trivial solid-state physics formulas. It's not a novel custom algorithm, but demands domain expertise to set up calculations and post-process results correctly.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves 3 sequential computational stages (structure relaxation, DFPT phonon/dielectric calculation, post-processing/compilation). Setting up Quantum ESPRESSO with appropriate pseudopotentials and parsing structured outputs adds moderate orchestration complexity, though each stage is a standard DFT step.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires replicating a standard but non-trivial DFPT workflow (conceptual 3) with 3-4 computational steps and careful environment setup (execution 3). Resources are modest: CPU-only DFT for 15-atom cells, <16GB RAM, negligible data, no GPU needed.
